'''April 2000 Tucson tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Tucson, Arizona on 29 April 2000. It is known from Enrique Huerta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d643">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-tucson-az-04-29-00d643/ tucson-az-04-29-00], DeckTech (Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta, 1 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-tucson-az-04-29-00d643/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Tucson, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
